content.en_us:
Thanks for trying the first pre-release of Gurkha Launcher! It is based on Zalith Launcher and PojavLauncher, and adds a fix for Minecraft 1.20.5+ on 32-bit ARM devices.

New versions and source code: https://github.com/kushaladhikari982648-lgtm/Gurkha-launcher
content.zh_cn:
感谢试用 Gurkha Launcher 的第一个预发布版本！它基于 Zalith Launcher 和 PojavLauncher，并修复了 Minecraft 1.20.5+ 在 32 位 ARM 设备上的问题。

新版本与源代码：https://github.com/kushaladhikari982648-lgtm/Gurkha-launcher
